title: Possible outcomes of one abstract step
statement: Let $m,d$ be natural numbers, let $\Lambda$ be a type, let $x$ be a finite bit string, let $A$ assign to each control state an instruction with $m$ registers, $d$ oracle indices, and states in $\Lambda$, and let $o$ be a Boolean oracle on indices in $\{0,\ldots,d-1\}$ and finite bit strings. For any control state $l$, register assignment $v:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\to\mathbb N$, and stored answer $res\in\{\mathrm{none},\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$, one abstract step from $(l,v,res)$ either yields an active configuration $(l',v',res)$ for some state $l'$ and register assignment $v'$, or yields a halted configuration $(\mathrm{none},v,\mathrm{some}(b))$ for some Boolean answer $b$.
hypotheses_covered: A program A mapping states to instructions with m registers, d oracle indices, and states in Λ
A Boolean oracle on indices in Fin d and finite bit strings
A register assignment v : Fin m → ℕ
A stored answer res : Option Bool
